# Claim Batches

## Purpose

Manages the end-to-end claim batches workflow for Claims Processing. The table is the authoritative work queue for creation, review, approval, posting or processing, exception handling, and audit.

This is a target-state specification. Existing Billing, Accounts, or Claims code may implement only a subset; the source-of-truth document and this specification define the intended refactor.

## Pharmacy-guided UI implementation

Follow the `/pharmacy` workspace conventions:

- `AsyncStateScaffold` → `ResponsivePage` → `AppWorkspace`
- One flat `AppTabStrip` (`frontend/lib/shared/components/app_tab_strip.dart`) holding the sections of the active category; the category itself is a sidebar menu item, not a tab
- `AppListTable` for the primary table, server pagination, saved columns, export, and print
- Row click opens `showAppDialog` / `AppDialog`; sections use `AppWorkspaceDetailPanel`
- Mutations use `AppWorkspaceMutationDialog` or `AppDialog`, not permanent create/edit tabs
- `AppAccessActionGate` hides unauthorized buttons; unavailable menu items and tabs are omitted
- `syncWorkspaceLocation` keeps the section slug, filters, and deep links synchronized
- The active surface's count badge comes from the filtered server total; sibling badge counts come from the workspace summary

See [../../_shared/workspace-pattern.md](../../_shared/workspace-pattern.md) for exact Pharmacy references and the target extraction pattern.

| 10 | `service_period_to` | Service Period To | date | Yes | Yes | No | Localized display; API remains ISO-8601; date filter enabled. |

| 17 | `batch_status` | Batch Status | status | Yes | Yes | Yes | Localized `AppWorkspaceStatusBadge`; never expose raw enum text. |

### Column defaults

- Freeze the first identifying reference and primary party/name columns.
- Default sort uses the most relevant business date descending, then human-friendly reference descending.
- Monetary totals are computed for the filtered result on the server, not only the visible page.
- Optional columns remain available in the column picker and exports.
- PHI and financial amounts are masked or omitted when ABAC scope does not permit them.

## Filters

| Filter | Control | Default | Behavior |
|---|---|---|---|
| Search | server text search | blank | Matches human-friendly reference and permitted display fields. |
| Status | multi-select | open/active | Only statuses applicable to this tab are offered. |
| Date/period | date range or fiscal period | current period | Uses facility timezone and inclusive boundaries. |
| Facility | multi-select | current facility | Restricted by tenant/facility ABAC scope. |
| Party | async search-select | all | Searches only parties visible in the user's ABAC scope. |
| Currency | select | base currency | Original-currency values remain available. |
| Amount range | minimum / maximum money | blank | Requires currency when mixed-currency rows are present. |
| Owner / assigned user | user search-select | all | Restricted to permitted facility staff. |

## CRUD and workflow contract

| Capability | Supported | Rules |
|---|:---:|---|
| Create | Yes | Opens a dialog; server assigns the human-friendly reference and safe initial status. |
| Read/list | Yes | Server-side paginated and ABAC-scoped. |
| Update | Yes | Master records use optimistic versioning; operational records are editable only before posting/finalization. |
| Delete | Conditional | Master data uses soft archive; draft-only administrative delete may be allowed. Posted financial records are never hard-deleted. |
| Approve | Yes | Maker-checker: creator cannot approve when segregation rules require independence. |
| Post/process | Yes | Atomic service transaction; period, entitlement, permission, and source-state checks are repeated server-side. |
| Reverse/void | Yes | Dedicated POST action with mandatory reason and linked correction; never overwrite posted history. |

All detail sections are collapsible `AppWorkspaceDetailPanel` instances. Mutations refresh the affected row, open detail, workspace counts, and shell badge without reloading unrelated tabs.

## Status model

| Status | Meaning | Allowed transition |
|---|---|---|
| Draft | Claim-related record is editable. | → Validated / Cancelled |
| Validated | Blocking validation passed. | → Submitted |
| Submitted | Sent to payer. | → In review / Rejected |
| In review | Awaiting payer decision. | → Approved / Partially approved / Denied |
| Approved / Partially approved | Adjudicated amount accepted. | → Paid / Appealed |
| Denied | Payer rejected all or part. | → Resubmitted / Appealed / Closed |
| Paid / Closed | Settlement complete. | Terminal except audited reopening |

Raw backend enums must map to localized hospital language and `AppWorkspaceStatusBadge` tones.

## Permissions and entitlement

| Capability | Effective requirement |
|---|---|
| Route/tab/read | `claims:read` ∩ `insurance-claims` |
| Create/update/process | `billing:write` ∩ `insurance-claims` |
| Approve/reject/finalize | `billing:write` ∩ `financial:approve` ∩ `insurance-claims` |
| Export/print | `claims:read` ∩ `evidence:export` ∩ `insurance-claims` |


> Claims currently reuses `billing:write` for mutations because the canonical permission catalog has no `claims:write`. Add a dedicated key to both backend and frontend catalogs before changing this contract.

Backend authorization is authoritative. Effective access is the union of grants intersected with subscription, assigned module, and ABAC scope. Denied menu entries and buttons are omitted rather than displayed as unusable chrome.

## Target API contract

| Operation | Method and target path | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| List | `GET /api/v1/claims-workspace/work-items?section=claim-batches` | `page`, `limit`, `sort_by`, `order`, search, filters; paginated `data` + `meta`. |
| Detail / drill-down | `GET /api/v1/claims-workspace/claim-batches/{human_friendly_id}` | Uses public human-friendly identifier or a stable report row key. |
| Create | `POST /api/v1/claims-workspace/claim-batches` | Idempotency key required for financial mutations. |
| Update draft | `PUT /api/v1/claims-workspace/claim-batches/{human_friendly_id}` | Optimistic `version`; only editable workflow states. |
| Workflow action | `POST /api/v1/claims-workspace/claim-batches/{human_friendly_id}/{action}` | Submit, approve, post/process, allocate, reverse, or void; reason required where applicable. |

- JSON fields are `snake_case`; DTOs map explicitly to Dart domain entities.
- Success responses use `success`, `data`, and `meta`; errors use one safe problem-details shape with a stable code.
- Online-only financial actions are never queued offline.
- Workspace events are reconciliation hints; the client performs a targeted authoritative refresh.

## Validation

- Client and server validate required values, lengths, formats, date ordering, and optimistic record version.
- Backend revalidates tenant, facility, department, ownership, entitlement, permission, and current workflow state.
- Public requests and responses use human-friendly identifiers; raw database IDs never appear.
- Duplicate submission is prevented with an idempotency key for financial mutations.
- Eligibility, coverage, authorization, required documents, deadlines, and payer rules are rechecked server-side.

Warnings are visibly distinct from blocking errors. Override actions require an allowed role, a reason, and an audit event.

## Audit and observability

- Log create, update, submit, approve/reject, post/process, allocation, reconciliation, reverse/void, archive/restore, export, and print events that apply.
- Capture actor, role, tenant/facility scope, timestamp, before/after summary, reason, source reference, version, IP/device context, and correlation ID.
- Never include secrets or unnecessary PHI in logs, errors, analytics, or export audit payloads.
- Record latency, result count, failures, and retry outcomes without exposing row data.
